title: Drill 2026-10-08: Mini crackme – rotate and add
blurb:
# Drill 2026-10-08: Mini crackme (Windows x64)

check(unsigned int x) is called with x in ecx. It must return 1 to "pass". Find the input.

check:
    mov  eax, ecx
    ror  eax, 12
    add  eax, 0x0BADF00D
    cmp  eax, 0x1234ABCD
    sete al
    movzx eax, al
    ret

What value of x (hex) returns 1?

---

**Answer:** x = 0x6BBC0068

1. The check computes ror(x,12) + 0x0BADF00D == 0x1234ABCD, so ror(x,12) = 0x1234ABCD - 0x0BADF00D = 0x0686BBC0.
2. ror is a rotate: bits falling off the low end re-enter at the top. Undo it with rol by the same count (12 bits = 3 hex digits).
3. rol(0x0686BBC0, 12): move the leading digits 068 to the end, giving 0x6BBC0068.
